title: Mapping machine configuration
statement: Given a finite Boolean Turing machine $M$, a Boolean input list $x$, a state or halting marker of its associated mapping machine, an input-head position in the range of positions for $x$, two Boolean lists $a,b$, two integer head positions $h_a,h_b$, and an output list, this defines a configuration on input $x$. Its work tapes contain the buffer for $a$ on the first tape, the buffer for $b$ on the next tape, and blank cells on the remaining tapes; the corresponding head positions are $h_a$ and $h_b$, with all remaining work heads at position zero.
hypotheses_covered: Input-head position in the valid range for $x$
